title: Return Policy - General
text: Most products can be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are unused and in original packaging. The return window starts from the delivery date recorded by the courier. Items must include all accessories, manuals and free gifts. Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after pickup verification.

title: Return Policy - Earbuds and Hygiene Products
text: In-ear headphones, earbuds and personal care products cannot be returned once the hygiene seal is broken. This restriction applies even if the product is otherwise unused. Customers may instead raise a warranty claim for functional defects within the manufacturer warranty period. Unopened units with an intact seal are eligible for a standard 7-day return.

title: Return Policy - Large Appliances
text: Air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines and other large appliances can be returned within 10 days of delivery only if there is a manufacturing defect confirmed by an authorised technician. Installation-related complaints must be raised within 48 hours. Returns require the original invoice and all installation kits.

title: Warranty - Standard Terms
text: All products carry the manufacturer warranty stated on the product page, typically 12 months for electronics and 24 months for premium audio. Warranty covers manufacturing defects only. Physical damage, liquid ingress and unauthorised repair void the warranty. Keep the invoice safe; it is mandatory for all claims.

title: Warranty - Extended Protection Plan
text: The Extended Protection Plan adds 12 months of coverage after the standard manufacturer warranty ends. It must be purchased within 30 days of the product invoice date. The plan covers labour and parts for functional failures but excludes accidental damage, theft and cosmetic wear. A maximum of two claims per year applies.

title: Warranty - Accessories
text: Chargers, cables, power banks and mice carry a 6-month warranty unless stated otherwise. Warranty claims for accessories require the serial number printed on the unit. Accessories purchased as part of a combo are covered under the combo invoice.

title: Refund Timelines
text: Refunds for prepaid orders are credited to the original card, UPI ID or wallet within 5-7 business days of return approval. Cash-on-delivery orders are refunded to a bank account and may take up to 10 business days. Shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to a seller error.

title: EMI and No-Cost EMI
text: No-cost EMI is available on orders above 5000 INR for select credit and debit cards. The interest component is provided as an upfront discount. Early closure of an EMI may attract processing fees from the issuing bank. EMI is not available on gift card purchases.

title: GST Invoice and Business Orders
text: Business customers can request a GST invoice by adding their GSTIN in the order notes before shipping. Invoices cannot be modified after dispatch. Bulk orders above 50 units qualify for dedicated account management and custom pricing.

title: Shipping and Delivery SLAs
text: Metro cities receive deliveries in 1-3 days. Tier-2 cities take 3-5 days and remote pin codes up to 7 days. Delivery attempts are made three times before the order is returned to the warehouse. Large appliances are delivered by a two-person team with scheduled appointments.

title: Cash on Delivery
text: Cash on delivery is available on orders up to 50000 INR. A handling fee of 49 INR applies. COD is not available for gold, gift cards and certain high-value electronics. Customers with more than two refused COD orders may lose COD eligibility.

title: Open Box Delivery
text: Open box delivery is available for selected pin codes on televisions and large appliances. The delivery agent will open the packaging in your presence so you can inspect for transit damage. Once the open box check is completed and the product is accepted, return requests for cosmetic issues are not accepted.

title: Damaged in Transit
text: If a product arrives damaged, raise a complaint within 24 hours with photographs of the outer box, inner packaging and the product. Do not discard the packaging until the claim is closed. Verified transit damage is replaced at no cost, including pickup and re-delivery.

title: Cancellation Policy
text: Orders can be cancelled free of charge before dispatch. After dispatch, cancellation is only possible before the first delivery attempt. Cancellations of personalised or made-to-order items are not permitted once production begins.

title: Exchange Policy
text: Exchanges are offered for size, colour and variant issues within 7 days for eligible categories. The replacement unit ships after the original is picked up and quality-checked. Price differences between variants are charged or refunded at the time of exchange.

title: Service Centre Process
text: Authorised service centres are listed on each brand page. Walk-in service requires the invoice and a photo ID. Pickup-and-drop service is available in 40 cities for laptops and large appliances. Average turnaround is 5-9 business days depending on parts availability.

title: Installation - Air Conditioners
text: Standard installation for split air conditioners is free and includes up to 3 metres of copper piping. Additional piping is charged at 650 INR per metre. Stabilisers, wall brackets and outdoor unit stands are chargeable extras. Installation must be completed within 15 days of delivery.

title: Installation - Washing Machines
text: Front-load washing machines include free installation and a demo session. Top-load and semi-automatic units are delivered ready to use with a user manual. Wall-mounted units require a site survey before installation.

title: Price Match Guarantee
text: If you find a lower price on an identical in-stock product at a major marketplace within 7 days of purchase, we will refund the difference. The comparison must include delivery charges and bank offers. Clearance and marketplace-only SKUs are excluded.

title: Gift Cards and Store Credit
text: Gift cards are valid for 12 months from activation and cannot be exchanged for cash. Store credit issued against returns expires in 6 months. Gift cards can be combined with one other payment method per order.

title: Loyalty Programme
text: Members earn 1 point per 100 INR spent. Points can be redeemed against accessories and extended warranty plans. Points expire 18 months after they are earned. Returns reverse the points earned on the returned item.

title: Data Privacy and Account Security
text: We store only the data required to fulfil orders and improve recommendations. Payment details are tokenised and never stored on our servers. You may request deletion of your account data at any time, subject to statutory record-keeping requirements.

title: International Shipping
text: International shipping is available to 18 countries. Import duties and customs clearance are the responsibility of the recipient. Warranty service for internationally shipped products must be handled in the country of purchase.

title: Warranty Claim - Dead on Arrival
text: A product that does not power on within 48 hours of delivery is treated as dead on arrival. DOA cases are replaced with a new unit rather than repaired. Report DOA issues through the order page with a short video of the failure.

title: Bulk and Corporate Purchases
text: Corporate buyers receive dedicated account managers, consolidated invoicing and net-30 payment terms after credit approval. Volume discounts start at 50 units. Demo units are available for evaluation on request.
